name: CyberCat
brief: Simplify CyberCat for a tiny desktop companion: broad purple/cyan shapes, a smooth consistent dark-purple outline, large simple eyes, a plain hoodie with one cyan dot and two collar stripes, mitten hands and plain boots. Preserve cat ears, headphones, purple bob hair with a cyan accent, and one clean cyan halo. Remove dense costume panels, hardware, tiny highlights, glitter, fine hair strands and glow. Keep cute blinking, waving, hopping, expectant waiting, thinking and expressive reactions. Generate genuine transparent alpha and coherent state/gaze strips from the same simplified canonical reference.
processing: Bundled work-pets 0.1.6 frame extraction, inspection, atlas composition, shared state transforms, look registration, structural validation and quality checks. Source imagery uses true alpha; chroma color correction is disabled (strength 0), preserving purple/cyan colors. Hidden RGB under zero alpha is cleared. GIF export uses a shared palette, alpha threshold 128, reserved transparency and no dithering. Each state retains its own pose motion and one common scale.
